title: Bin Ranges API
description: The Bin Ranges API manages the BIN (Bank Identification Number) ranges owned by a partner, including the card-number sub-ranges that each range covers.

apis.heading: Create Bin Range
apis.description: Create a new bin range together with the card-number sub-ranges it covers.

reqParams.name: description
reqParams.description: A description of the bin range.

reqParams.name: rangesIncluded
reqParams.description: The card-number sub-ranges covered by this bin range.

reqParams.name: start
reqParams.description: Inclusive start of the BIN sub-range.

reqParams.name: end
reqParams.description: Inclusive end of the BIN sub-range.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: The created bin range.

resParams.name: binRangeId
resParams.description: Unique identifier of the created bin range.

resParams.name: partnerId
resParams.description: Identifier of the partner that owns the bin range.

resParams.name: description
resParams.description: Description supplied when the bin range was created.

resParams.name: rangesIncluded
resParams.description: The card-number sub-ranges stored for this bin range.

resParams.name: start
resParams.description: Inclusive start of the BIN sub-range.

resParams.name: end
resParams.description: Inclusive end of the BIN sub-range.

resParams.name: description
resParams.description: A description of this sub-range.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: List Bin Ranges
apis.description: Fetch a paginated list of the partner's bin ranges.
apis.query: To page through results send the requested page in the x-page-number header.

reqParams.name: includeInactive
reqParams.description: Whether inactive bin ranges are included in the results.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: The list of bin ranges for the current page.

resParams.name: binRangeId
resParams.description: Unique identifier of the bin range.

resParams.name: partnerId
resParams.description: Identifier of the partner that owns the bin range.

resParams.name: description
resParams.description: Description supplied when the bin range was created.

resParams.name: rangesIncluded
resParams.description: The card-number sub-ranges stored for this bin range.

resParams.name: start
resParams.description: Inclusive start of the BIN sub-range.

resParams.name: end
resParams.description: Inclusive end of the BIN sub-range.

resParams.name: description
resParams.description: A description of this sub-range.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.
